question: A relationship manager is asking where PAY-3103 is. What should I tell them?

answer.question: A relationship manager is asking where PAY-3103 is. What should I tell them?
answer.answer:
PAY-3103 is at **"Scheme acknowledged."** The Cross-Border Wire for EUR 48,200.00 (Wide World Importers to Lucerne Publishing) was released to the scheme at 08:15 and acknowledged at 08:21 on Mar 12, 2026.

You can tell the RM:

> "PAY-3103 for EUR 48,200.00 is at stage 'Scheme acknowledged.' Settlement is expected by 15:00 on Mar 12, 2026 (beneficiary bank cutoff). I will confirm once settlement is reported."

Settlement has not been reported yet, so don't tell the RM it has settled.
